text:
Weekly rebalance day, first full-size week. Market GREEN (VIX 16). Futures are slightly lower (S&P -0.1%, Nasdaq -0.3%); Asia rallied after Friday's soft jobs data. Rising 10-year yields (5.29%) and a stronger dollar are mild headwinds. ISM Services is out at 10:00 ET.
SNOW: sell everything (rotated out; rank #2 to #9). It exits with a ~+3.3% gain.
ALAB #1: Q2 revenue +104%, Q3 guidance implies ~40% growth from Q2, and Scorpio switches are shipping early. It is still the most volatile pick (-19% over 3 months before its earnings jump), so size discipline and the stop matter.
DELL #2: $95B AI-server backlog and revenue +58%. Analysts are cautious on upside from here (TD Cowen Hold).
MU #3: memory boom (revenue +379%) and a buyback starts in December.
AMD and INTC slipped to #4 and #5. Intel is down ~4% pre-market on news about Musk's Terafab chip project, which is a reminder that semis can move together.
All three picks are AI-hardware names. The 8% stops and 10% portfolio brake are the safety net.

cautions.why: Highest volatility of the three (3-mo -19% before the earnings gap); respect the 322.30 stop.
All AI-hardware: a semis/AI selloff hits all three together. Earnings: ALAB Nov 3 (inside the window, before Diwali).
